subject.title: feat(workshop): allow restoring rejected proposals back to pending

question: Should Skill Workshop rejection be reversible through an operator-only restore action, and may that action clear rejection metadata without retaining durable lifecycle history?
rationale: The patch can implement either policy correctly, but source inspection cannot determine whether rejection is intended as a terminal review decision or whether the linked issue's audit-history request is a required product contract.

options.title: Approve current-state restore
options.body: Keep restoration operator-only, clear the rejection fields as proposed, and document that Skill Workshop stores the current lifecycle state rather than a durable event history.

options.title: Require lifecycle history
options.body: Keep restoration but preserve a durable rejection/restoration event or equivalent audit record before merging.

options.title: Keep rejection terminal
options.body: Decline the new transition and close this PR together with the paired feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve current-state restore
recommendation.body: Keep restoration operator-only, clear the rejection fields as proposed, and document that Skill Workshop stores the current lifecycle state rather than a durable event history.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is repository-level product and persisted-lifecycle policy rather than a mechanical code repair.
